$comment: The locales THIS repo translates into, and the subset that gates.
`targets` is every locale this repo translates into. A locale belongs here
once its content does: listing one whose files have not landed yet makes every
script iterate a locale with nothing in it, so the list grows in the same
change that brings the content. It is EMPTY today, deliberately. Which locales
are in scope for launch is an open decision (see CLAUDE.md, 'Open questions'),
and this file is not where it gets made by accident.
`productionTargets` is the subset held to a production standard. It does two
jobs, and both follow from one promise: a production-locale user never sees
untranslated text.
- it is the only thing `scripts/validate.mjs` exits non-zero on. Errors
outside it are still found, printed and counted; they do not gate.
- it is the list `scripts/completeness.mjs` holds a SOURCE repo's PR to: a PR
that changes English cannot merge until every locale here holds the
translation.
It is EMPTY today because no locale is in production yet. Unlike Jiki's repo,
where an empty list is a fatal misconfiguration, empty is a legitimate state
here, so the scripts accept it and SAY SO on every run: a gate that gates on
nothing must never be mistaken for a green one. A missing or non-array list,
or a locale `targets` does not know, is still fatal.
Joining `productionTargets` comes first and being served comes second. The
website's own list of served locales (config/initializers/locale.rb,
`I18n.available_locales`) answers a different question, and every locale it
serves must already be here.
English is not a target locale and never appears in either list. It is not
stored in this repo at all. See ENGLISH-SOURCE.md.
